The Mysterious Man has yet to visit, and the method of making ice treats remains undecided. To address this, we revisited the laborers working in the fields along the Qinghe line, hoping to find a new solution to relieve the scorching heat.
Upon arriving at the Palace of Annals, we saw a man with his chest bare… his robes disheveled, sweating profusely. Soon after, he swung a massive sword, spinning in place. The sword's wind howled, kicking up dust and sand, blowing away his sweat and dispersing the summer heat from the entire pool! Bottoms Up Winner—
This is the "Sword Spin" technique, an excellent way to beat the heat! But how could ordinary people lift such a massive sword and spin endlessly?
Alas… it’s not that the great sword is unaffordable, but ice treats simply offer better value for money!
